title: CIA regressionists regress Burroughs from the Rendlesham case
place_text: New York (Sandler studio); Rendlesham Forest case

tellings.quote: I got guys I got two guys and they were CIA is regressionists that that regressed uh um Bros from the runners from forest case

plain: In the 1980s, two CIA hypnotists who used regression, a method of guiding someone back through buried memories, are said to have regressed John Burroughs, a witness from a UFO case in Rendlesham Forest in England. A guest named Grant Cameron repeats this from people he knows. He says "I got two guys and they were CIA regressionists," names Bob Emenegger and Allan Sandler in connection with the story, and places the sessions at Sandler's studio in New York. If true, it would mean the CIA quietly took an interest in what that witness remembered.
